note: Training use of API inputs according to each provider's public documentation (AI-018). Own wording, no quotes. EU processing details (AI-019) follow in release 1.2.

anthropic.summary: Inputs and outputs of commercial products such as the API are not used for model training by default.

openai.summary: Data sent to the API is not used for training unless the organisation opts in to data sharing.

openrouter.summary: OpenRouter's own use of inputs and outputs is an account setting that is off by default. For the providers a request is routed to, the page only refers to separate information; it does not state their training use.

gemini.summary: Paid services: prompts and responses are not used to improve products. Unpaid services: content may be used to improve products and machine learning technologies, including human review.

ollama.summary: Local operation: Ollama itself does not see prompts or data; inputs stay on this computer or on the Ollama server set in the settings, and no provider uses them for training.
